description.value: Quality Foods is a BC-based independent supermarket chain with a strong presence on Vancouver Island. The Parksville location on Alberni Highway serves as a full-service grocery stop with fresh produce, bakery, deli, and a wide range of household goods. For touring cyclists passing through the Parksville area, it offers a comprehensive resupply option in a convenient highway-side location.
